item.text: The focused rerun exposed two specification contradictions, not an evaluator defect: `range(0, 1; 3, 4)` correctly produces the 12-value jq cartesian product, while the acceptance oracle expects only 7 values; and jq’s `.[]` on scalar inputs raises a runtime error, while the order check expects each scalar unchanged. I’m running all four declared checks exactly once more to document the evidence before stopping under the AC_BROKEN rule.
